title: astragalus barrelieri var. queraltii
intro: Astragalus barrelieri var. queraltii, commonly known as  Spanish milkvetch, is a plant species within the legume family. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its potential to support the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus barrelieri var. queraltii include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
